headline: Meeta Samir Sheth files SEBI takeover disclosure for substantial stake in Coral India Finance & Housing Limited
sum: Meeta Samir Sheth has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Coral India Finance & Housing Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure under India's takeover code, though the specific consideration and exact shareholding percentage are not disclosed in the public summary.
detail: Meeta Samir Sheth submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) to the NSE. This regulation mandates that any person acquiring 25% or more of a listed company's shares (directly or indirectly) must disclose the acquisition and may be required to make a mandatory open offer unless exempted. Coral India Finance & Housing Limited is a BFSI entity listed on NSE. The disclosure was filed on 6 July 2026.
